html:
With plots of 1 × 1 (1 basic plots each), the CV between plots is 43.5% for grape, 31.1% for peach, 22.7% for apple and 20.8% for tomato.

Grape starts out the most variable and falls fastest (b = 1.02): its plots vary almost independently, so merging them works. Peach (b = 0.38) barely improves past four basic plots. Its map shows why, with whole bands of the field above or below average.
